method: Nonblank physical Rust lines including comments. Reviewed complete positive cfg(test)/cfg(all(test,...)) spans and test-only modules are support; feature/production cfg(any(...,test)) remains production. Adjacent non-test comments remain production. Unchanged baseline categories inherited; no universal reclassification.
scope: All repository tracked .rs source at baseline plus the four manifest-added .rs paths. No Git dependency source, target/build outputs, patch text, duplicated evidence or documentation counted. Shared workbench counted once in BelloBox; BelloAgent Git dependency is excluded.
validation: Existing independently reviewed r3 source and supplied App/core/lint receipts are preserved, not rerun by this LOC audit. LOC is neither an ETA nor a parity/completion measure.
